welcome.title: Welcome to Wisp
welcome.description: Select, capture or copy, press a shortcut, and the result appears right next to your cursor. Setup takes about a minute.

feature_desc.translate_selection: Select text in any app and watch the translation stream in
feature_desc.ocr: Drag over any part of the screen to recognize its text
feature_desc.clipboard: Find anything you copied and paste it in one step

permissions.title: Grant two permissions
permissions.description: macOS needs your permission for Wisp to read selected text and the screen.
permissions.privacy: Wisp reads the selection or the screen only when you press a shortcut — never in the background.
permissions.relaunch_hint: Already switched it on in System Settings? Screen Recording takes effect after Wisp relaunches.
permissions.lost_title: System permissions were reset by the update.
permissions.lost_detail: In System Settings, select Wisp and remove it with “−”, then add it again — or turn the switch off and on.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.why: Read the selected text and paste clipboard items back into apps

screen_recording.title: Screen Recording
screen_recording.why: Screenshot OCR needs to read what’s on screen

model.title: Connect a model
model.description: Translation and screenshot OCR run on the model you choose. Your API key stays in the system credential store.
model.openai_protocol: Responses is OpenAI’s newer, recommended protocol; Chat is more widely compatible
model.key_hint: Saved to the system credential store when you continue.
model.sync_link: Already use Wisp on another device? Connect sync

try.title: Try it
try.description: Try Wisp’s two main shortcuts on the text below.
try.sample: Wisp stays out of your way: it idles at near-zero CPU, wakes in milliseconds, and streams the translation right next to your cursor.

task.translate_selection: Select the text above, then press

task_nokey.translate_selection: Select the text above, then press the “Translate selection” shortcut
task_nokey.clipboard: Press the “Clipboard” shortcut to open your clipboard history

hint.translate_selection: The panel appears next to the selection and the translation streams in
hint.clipboard: Everything you copied recently is here

try.unavailable: Global shortcuts aren’t available here — use “Try it now” instead.

try.more_nokey: You can also start screenshot OCR any time from the tray menu.
